summary: Completed comprehensive V2 testing of Interview AI Assistant - All backend APIs working (12/12), frontend pages load correctly with French UI and dark theme, split-view interview page functional, mobile responsive design working, navigation flow operational
passed_tests: GET /api/health returns 200 status
GET /api/settings returns settings with API key already configured (has_key=true)
POST /api/settings successfully saves API key and model preferences
POST /api/settings/validate-key validates API keys correctly
GET /api/sessions returns sessions list (empty initially)
GET /api/sessions/stats returns aggregated statistics
POST /api/sessions creates new session successfully
GET /api/sessions/{id}/messages returns empty messages for new session
DELETE /api/sessions/{id} removes session correctly
GET /api/cv/active returns existing CV data (Samantha Akkouche CV)
Home page loads with hero section, how-it-works, features grid, and CTA buttons
Dashboard shows stats cards, sessions list, CV widget with active CV, and quick actions
Settings page displays API key status (configured), model selector, and CV section with uploaded CV
Sessions page shows stats grid and empty sessions state with proper French labels
Interview page renders with split-view layout: transcript panel (left) and suggestions panel (right)
Interview page shows status badges: CV actif, FR language, timer, En attente status
Interview page controls bar with start/stop buttons functional
Mobile responsiveness: interview page shows tab toggle between transcript/suggestions
Mobile tabs functional on 390x844 viewport with proper panel switching
Navigation flow: Home -> Dashboard -> Settings -> Sessions -> Interview all accessible
Back navigation works correctly from all pages
No critical console errors found during navigation
French UI text displaying correctly throughout the application
Dark cyberpunk theme with proper colors and gradients implemented
All interactive elements (buttons, forms, tabs) are clickable and responsive
